recheckNote: All first-party pages below were re-read on 2026-10-28. BrightFunded's help list (updated 2026-09-15) still names Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Vietnam and Pakistan for people residing in or holding nationality of those countries; its Terms section 2 still keeps MT5 away from US/UAE residents or citizens. Crypto Fund Trader's Terms 7.3 and FAQ (both updated 2026-03-30) publish no country restriction for one platform and exclude US residents from MT5. FundedNext's site-wide Jurisdictional Restrictions text (homepage footer and Terms, last updated 5 May 2026) names Russia and Belarus by residence, so Russia is now in its restricted list in line with firms.json; its CFD list (updated 2026-08-27) and MetaQuotes US notice are unchanged and its Futures list still names Ukraine. Separate product: BrightFunded Futures (help article updated 2026-10-26) restricts residents, citizens and people located in Russia, Belarus and Ukraine; this matrix covers the BrightFunded Challenge list only. This checks published lists only, not registration, KYC, payment or payout eligibility.
scopeRu: Срез сравнивает только опубликованные фирмами списки стран и отдельные ограничения продукта или платформы. Доступ определяют страна проживания и документы KYC, а не язык. Это не письменное разрешение: регистрацию, KYC, оплату и выплату конкретному человеку мы не тестировали.
